# PickedZ

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Picking](Blitz3D-Picking)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
PickedZ:Float32
```

## Description

**Works in:** Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

## Parameters

**Returns:** The world Z coordinate of the point where the latest pick touched an entity.
